WITH per_event_name AS (
    SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_budgeted_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_name
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_budgeted_amount) AS mean_of_averages
    FROM per_event_name
)
SELECT p.event_name,
       p.avg_budgeted_amount,
       p.avg_budgeted_amount - o.mean_of_averages AS above_mean_by,
       p.avg_budgeted_amount / o.mean_of_averages AS ratio_to_mean
FROM per_event_name AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.avg_budgeted_amount > o.mean_of_averages;
